themeDescription: Rushed shoppers, queue jumping & express checkout

challenges.title: Express Gift Wrap for Birthday in 10 Minutes
challenges.shortDescription: Expedite wrapping and personalized ribboning for an anxious parent on their way to a birthday party.
challenges.mission: Work swiftly, select pre-cut wrapping paper and quick stick bows, while maintaining quality presentation.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Please! I am already 15 minutes late for my daughter's best friend's birthday party down the road! Can you wrap this doll set with a nice ribbon in literally two minutes?!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: speed without looking like a sloppy job

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Checks watch repeatedly and taps counter.
hiddenObjectives: Prepare gift tag and bill simultaneously
possibleSolutions: Express gift bag with tissue styling
Rapid fold wrapping with stick bow

challenges.title: Airport Transit Queue Jump Request
challenges.shortDescription: Manage an airport mall traveler whose gate closes in 25 minutes wanting to bypass a long checkout line without offending others.
challenges.mission: Address traveler panic, communicate respectfully with other queue members, or open an express terminal.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Excuse me everyone! My flight to Dubai is boarding right now at Gate 14 and security takes 15 minutes! Can I please just buy this box of chocolates and skip the line? I'm begging you!

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Attempts to push to front of queue while clutching boarding pass.
hiddenObjectives: Direct traveler to auxiliary express terminal
Ask polite permission from next customer in line
Complete contactless tap payment in 15 seconds

challenges.title: Closing Shutter Urgent Interview Shirt Need
challenges.shortDescription: Assist an anxious job candidate arriving as store shutters are pulling down, needing a white shirt for an 8 AM interview tomorrow.
challenges.mission: Show situational compassion, retrieve the correct size crisp white shirt quickly, and process a swift closing register transaction.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Wait, please don't pull down the shutter! I spilled coffee all over my only formal shirt, and I have a dream job interview at 8 AM tomorrow! Just give me any white formal shirt in size 40, I have exact cash!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting a proper formal shirt tonight

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Begs for 2 minutes of staff time past official closing bell.
hiddenObjectives: Fetch standard size 40 white shirt in 30 seconds
Ring up transaction before registers shut down

challenges.title: Double-Parked High Street Shopper Demanding 60-Sec Billing
challenges.shortDescription: Maintain accuracy, inventory scanning, and calm customer service while a driver urges staff to hurry before police tow their car.
challenges.mission: Maintain professional scanning rhythm, prevent bagging errors, and complete payment smoothly under high customer agitation.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Brother, my car is double-parked on MG Road with hazard lights on! The traffic police tow truck is right behind! Scan these three items in ten seconds, please hurry hurry!

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: getting out before receiving a 1,500 rupee traffic fine

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Throws items on counter and readies phone scanner.
